Bar/lounge in Ho Chi Minh City, VN
Dec 2025 • Friends
Came here recently Sunday night—had reservations and got a table on the ground floor near the stage. Not sure if this table is considered a hot spot but it was too close to the speakers so it was too loud. The MC talks to much in the beginning and his voice is played super loud on the sound system, quite annoying. Once the music starts and the singers/band come out, it’s more enjoyable. They did pause the music to have guests come up on stage and play a game, which was entertaining.

Food here was terrible—everything is bland and not well flavored, we did not enjoy the food. For drinks, they have beer towers which is good for groups. This place has an energetic ambiance but is too loud if you’re trying to enjoy a dinner meal, and even so, the food is underwhelming.

I had dinner at The Gangs on Mạc Đĩnh Chi and really enjoyed the experience. The restaurant has a cool, modern vibe with a relaxed atmosphere that makes it great for groups of friends . Awesome evening vibe and great food!
Nov 2024 • Friends
I had an amazing evening with friends at The Gangs Central. The ambiance of the place is truly impressive with its open, modern, and incredibly "cool" design. The food selection is diverse, offering delicious Vietnamese, European, and Japanese dishes – the grilled items and their signature craft beers were particularly outstanding. The staff were quick, enthusiastic, and very professional. The music was great and the atmosphere was lively, making it a perfect spot to gather and unwind after a stressful day at work. We thoroughly enjoyed our evening here. Will definitely come back and recommend it to friends! Absolutely deserves 5 stars!

Great Vibes, Fun Nights & Tasty Food at The Urban Gangs!
Mar 2025 • Friends
We stumbled upon The Urban Gangs in Ho Chi Minh and ended up going back the very next night—yep, it was that good!

The vibe really picks up after 9 PM—it's electric and super contagious. The bartenders not only serve drinks but also dance and pull off fun tricks right on the main floor. It’s like dinner and a show rolled into one.

We loved how the cocktails and beers come in towers—great for sharing and keeping the party going. The food was amazing too. We ordered the kimchi soup, chicken cartilage, and a big sharing platter. Everything was packed with flavor and perfect for the setting.

If you're looking for a place with great music, high energy, awesome drinks, and tasty bites, The Urban Gangs is the spot. Highly recommend it for a fun night out in Ho Chi Minh City!

Insider tip:
Go around 8.30 as the vibe kicks in after 9.

Mosquitos spoilt the meal
Feb 2025 • Couples
Had a good meal here , both me and my partner have very different tastes but both able to find something we both liked . I had bacon and mushroom rolls with french fries which was very tasty and beautifully presented with a large mixed salad . My partner had pork ribs , a substantial meal , which was also nicely presented. The price was reasonable for the meal . It was late afternoon so we had the place to ourselves . It’s very large and I can imagine it has a great atmosphere when it is busy. 
However, the experience was marred before we started to eat . By the time I had chosen my meal off the menu I had been bitten by mosquito six times . My partner was also bitten . I had sprayed myself with 50 % deet earlier in the day and have been in the far east for three weeks in both rural and city locations and avoided any bites . I was mystified as to why the mosquitoes were biting me in a large restaurant, but realised as I left there was a soak away in the floor full of water which was probably the source . 
Therefore if you are going to eat here make sure you cover yourself in anti mosquito spray before you go in as the restaurant makes no attempt to deal with them
